scripts.codegen: pnpm --filter @helm/openapi codegen && pnpm --filter @helm/api-client-ts codegen && pnpm --filter @helm/api-client-dart codegen
scripts.codegen:check: pnpm codegen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/api-client-ts packages/api-client-dart || (echo 'Generated clients are dirty. Do not hand-edit; regenerate from OpenAPI.' && exit 1)
